mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the risk-free rate in equity valuation models, compressing discount rates and increasing present values of future cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market that increases consumer spending power and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% for 3 months), reduced industrial output signals weakening corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% for 3 months over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate sustained consumer spending, which directly supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% year-over-year over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a virtuous cycle of rising consumer income and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both PAYEMS and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion (HOUST above 1300), increased home construction activity boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is above 1300 over a 5-year rolling window.
